summary: An official Discord event, Meme Spotlight, is running from November 7 to November 15 UTC with the theme 'Talents'. Players can submit memes in the #meme-spotlight channel, with talent-themed memes granting specific rewards. Submitting a talent meme earns 3 Heliolite Dice, while the community-voted top meme wins 500 Wyrmarrow and a temporary Meme Lord role.
tips: Post a talent-themed meme in the #meme-spotlight Discord channel between Nov 7 and Nov 15 UTC to claim 3 Heliolite Dice.
The weekly top meme chosen by community reactions earns 500 Wyrmarrow and the temporary Meme Lord role.
title: New Meme Theme: TALENTS! 🎲 Free Heliolite Dice on the Official Discord | Dragonheir #shorts
